description: The /v2 daily-fortune card's 'ควรเลี่ยง' (worst) text must be read from bazi's summaryItems BY KEY (key==='worst'), never by position. bazi /api/home forwards 5 KEYED items (best · worst · strength · element · officer); the old bestWorstText took summaryItems[last] = 'officer' ('ดูแลเอาใจใส่'), so 'ควรเลี่ยง' rendered the OPPOSITE meaning of key==='worst' ('อยู่บ้าน / คุมลูกน้อง / อยู่ในห้อง') — a daily inverted message the user read as ground truth. Fix: match by key per-field, fall back to facets-by-percent only when a keyed item is absent. gate_layer=data/normalize (pure). Teeth (home-fortune-best-worst.test.ts, neg-control-first): fix 5/5; MUTANT restore-to-[last] → 4 fail (worst='ดูแลเอาใจใส่' caught); restore → 5/5. Live A/B proven on the real /v2 route (goo verify): fixed FE shows worst='อยู่บ้าน...' vs old FE shows 'ดูแลเอาใจใส่' for the same user — matches บอง's raw-bazi check.
